description: This file defines a singleton helper class 'RefreshBroadcast' in the BlazorAdmin.Helpers namespace. It provides an event-based mechanism to broadcast refresh requests across the application by exposing a static instance and an event that other parts of the application can subscribe to and invoke.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a mechanism to broadcast a refresh request event to other components.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Triggers the 'RefreshRequested' event to notify subscribers that a refresh has been requested.
